_comment: Copy to var/webhook-endpoints.json and chmod 600 — the gateway
refuses to start on a registry anyone else can read.
Two credentials per endpoint, and they must differ. The pusher's
ingest_secret ends up somewhere exposed (a TradingView indicator
input every viewer of a shared chart can read); the puller's
read_token lives in your terminal. One credential for both would
mean anyone who sees your chart reads every delivery.
Values support ${ENV_VAR} expansion, so this file can be committed
while the secrets stay in the environment. Delete this _comment key
before use — it is not a valid endpoint.
